item.title: Solomon Islands Enters Security Treaty With Australia, in a Blow to China
item.description: A 2022 Solomon Islands agreement with China had raised concerns it would enable Beijing to establish a military presence on the Pacific island. The new accord precludes such bases.

item.title: Colombia’s Leader Blames ‘Terrorist Attack’ for Power Outages
item.description: The blackouts follow a string of violent episodes attributed to Colombia’s armed traffickers, as the country’s new president cracks down on the groups.

item.title: 2 Men Charged After Break-In at Prince William and Kate’s Country Home
item.description: Prosecutors said the two men, who appeared in court on Wednesday, had climbed a drainpipe to break into the royals’ country retreat in Norfolk.

item.title: Radio Offers Russian Troops Classic Rock, Nostalgia — and Pleas to Surrender
item.description: What seem like frontline Russian radio stations are actually a Ukrainian psychological operation, hoping to sow despair among the Kremlin’s soldiers.

item.title: Africa C.D.C. Chief Faces Turmoil Over Management Amid Ebola Crisis
item.description: Scrutiny has fallen on Dr. Jean Kaseya, the director general of the Africa Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, after reports of staff intimidation and mismanagement of funds.
